dialogue.text: [wry, storytelling] Level five is a million dollars. The next customer is a retired engineer, and he skips the line completely. Earl holds a side door open for him, and he disappears into a private room with leather armchairs.

[wry, storytelling] The lobby coffee machine has been out of order for three weeks, but in here there's an espresso machine, and Jess gets sent in to make him one. On his table sits a jar of nice pens, and not one of them is chained down.
We have oat milk in here? Out there, we chain the pens.

[wry, storytelling] He just moved his savings here from the bank across the street, and this bank paid him to do it. At Chase, new customers who bring over that kind of money have been offered bonuses of up to three thousand dollars, just for moving it.
[wry, storytelling] So Jess paid thirty-five dollars for being short, and he got paid for crossing the street.
At a million, you're a guest.
